caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile object, likely a woven fabric or blanket, featuring an intricate pattern composed primarily of red and white colors with shades of maroon or brown. The fabric is laid out flat with the bottom left corner folded over, revealing the reverse side, which displays a similar decorative motif but with inverted colors. The main body of the fabric is adorned with repeating rows of floral, foliate, and geometric designs arranged in alternating patterns across the surface. Notably, there are large square medallions with elaborate floral motifs, bordered by horizontal bands containing smaller floral and scroll patterns. The upper and lower edges of the textile are finished with a fringe in the same red and maroon hues, extending outward with individual strands visible. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white, emphasizing the details and color contrasts of the fabric.
title: Coverlet
